// A from-nothing environment for the real `claude`: an empty home and config folder inside the scratch folder,
// a made-up token and a loopback API host, so no sign-in on this machine can be read or used.
import path from "node:path";
export const SCRATCH = process.env.VERIFY_SCRATCH;
export const CLAUDE = `${process.env.TARSEE_NODE_PROJECT}/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-win32-x64/claude.exe`;
export const HOME = path.join(SCRATCH, "real", "home");
export function cleanEnv(extra = {}) {
  const env = {};
  for (const k of ["PATH", "PATHEXT", "SystemRoot", "SystemDrive", "COMSPEC", "TEMP", "TMP", "windir", "NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS", "OS", "PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE", "ProgramFiles", "ProgramData"]) if (process.env[k]) env[k] = process.env[k];
  return {
    ...env,
    HOME, USERPROFILE: HOME,
    TEMP: path.join(SCRATCH, "real", "tmp"), TMP: path.join(SCRATCH, "real", "tmp"),
    APPDATA: path.join(SCRATCH, "real", "appdata"), LOCALAPPDATA: path.join(SCRATCH, "real", "localappdata"),
    CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: path.join(HOME, ".claude"),
    ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: "http://127.0.0.1:9", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: "made-up-token-for-a-loopback-fake",
    CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC: "1", DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER: "1", DISABLE_TELEMETRY: "1", DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING: "1",
    CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: "0",
    ...extra,
  };
}
